meta.source: SemanticKITTI seq 08 (held-out VAL_SEQUENCES split), frames 300-699 (real data) -- includes a real ~173deg cumulative heading change (a turn, verified from poses.txt) across roughly frames 400-600 of this window, with straight driving before and a new environment after
meta.note: avg per-frame mIoU on this specific 400-frame window is 0.505, notably below the checkpoint's held-out validation mIoU (see 'checkpoint' above) -- this window uses uniform random downsampling at inference (inference.classify() has no ground truth to do class-aware sampling with, unlike train.py's validation), which under-represents rare classes like static_obstacle_pole/dynamic_pedestrian more than the reported validation number does. For the pitch, cite the held-out validation mIoU as the model's real accuracy figure, not this demo clip's average.
